chronicle.extra-enchantry.line1: In the Primordial Era, eight pillars held up the sky.
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line2: Soul kept the boundary of life and death, Storm commanded the heavens, Blade waged the wars, Nature nurtured all living things;
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line3: Abyss walked unseen, Wind soared the heights, Guard swore to the shield, Fire burned unextinguished.
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line4: Then the Cataclysm of Realms fell in four acts: the Abyss Awakened, the Storm Unraveled, the Flames Consumed, the Souls Lost their Way.
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line5: Eight families forged the Vessel of the Limit, sealing the Cataclysm with eight inscriptions —
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line6: and when it was done, the pillars fell; the inscriptions shattered into shards, sinking into every enchantment of the age to come.
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line7: The ages buried the names of the First Ones, but never the echoes of their script:
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line8: the edge of Judgement, the whisper of Life Erosion, the thunder of Limit Break, the gift of Loam... all testimonies of the old world.
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line9: Then, a wanderer picked up the first shard.
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line10: The wanderer gathered the echoes of eight families, walked the eight trials, and reforged the Vessel of the Limit through the Cataclysm.
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line11: Eight sigils became one; eight inscriptions answered in unison —
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line12: the Primordial Era gained its sequel, written by this Grand Resonator.
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line13: The Era of Inscription never ends. As long as someone still picks up an enchanted book,
chronicle.extra-enchantry.line14: the whisper of the First Ones lingers: "Welcome back, Resonator."
